title: Paladin Guide
subtitle: Amarr Marauder
body:
# Paladin

---

The Paladin is an Amarr marauder and is a primary DPS ship in fleets. 

## Key Points

- Activate Bastion when in position. It locks you in place for 60 seconds but dramatically boosts your  damage.
- Don't bastion with aggro unless an FC tells you to.
- Use Conflagration for close range (<45), Scorch for longer range(>45). Switch ammo types based on what range you're shooting.
- Use your armor rep when battle reps are called for.
- Use your cap transmitter when battle caps are called for or when a ship asks for it.
- Auto repeat off is stupid. You lose 3% dps because you aren't smart enough to press a button once at the end of the site.
- Overbastioning by 10 seconds is better than under bastioning by 50 seconds.

## Bastion Timing

- NRF- get to your anchor then bastion for the remainder of the site. If you get initial aggro on entry then you can wait until the switch to bastion first cycle.
- TPPH - room 1 and 2 you do not bastion. Room 3 get to your anchor and bastion until the tower is low armor/enters hull. 
- TCRC Boomer strat - If you are not assigned: a role bastion one cycle on the beacon. once you exit bastion mjd and bastion one more time. Follow FC directions for any additional bastion cycles but you should only bastion twice.
- TCRC Split strat - If you are not assigned: a role bastion one cycle on the beacon. once you exit bastion mjd and bastion one more time. Follow FC directions for any additional bastion cycles but you should only bastion twice.

## Anchoring
- NRF Straight - Jump straight forward, burn back approximately 20 km. 
- NRF Side - Jump at approximately 30 degrees clockwise of straight forward. 
- TPPH - Rooms 1-2 burn to out gate, Room three left of the tower and not below the meatshield. 
- TCRC - Beacon then slightly left of the tower.

## Target Priority

- NRF Straight
    - Wave 1 - mara, frigates, rest
    - Wave 2 - romi, osti, antem, yulai, rest
    - Wave 3 - mara, romi, antem, yulai, rest
    - Wave 4 - outuni, romi, intaki, deltole, rest

- NRF Side
    - Wave 1 - mara, frigates, rest
    - Wave 2 - antem, yulai, rest
    - Wave 3 - antem, yulai, rest
    - Wave 4 - antem, yulai, rest

- TPPH
    - Room 1 - tama, outuni, auga, osti, rest
    - Room 2 - mara, antem, deltole, romi, osti, rest
    - Room 3 Wave 1 - mara, frigates, romi, ostingle
    - Room 3 Wave 2 - romi, intaki, deltole, ostingle (if you shoot frigates i will personally punch you in the face.)
    - Room 3 Wave 3 - outuni, antem, yulai, rest (frigates last)

- TCRC 
    - Deltole>Outini's>untagged Ostingele until you can jump, then untagged Schmaeel's after jumping. Once Schmaeel's are dead shoot the tower. Be prepared to shoot Yulai or Ostingele if the FC calls for it. Once the tower dies kill the auga and the Schmaeel's.

## Fleet Roles
- MTAC - Person is responsible for MTAC-ing in the TCRC site. See <insert mtac guide link>
- Pally Squad - Multibox (2-5) paladins that jump to the right of the TCRC tower and shoot 3-5 Yulai. This role is mostly outdated and likely will be shot in the head at some point.
- NRF side jumper - This role is not noted in the MOTD but should be done by 9-12 paladins they shoot the sniper waves in NRF's and jump slightly differently than the main fleet.


## Upgrade planning
get to the dps requirement->get ascendancies->get the rest of the pod->get faction bastion->upgrade damage mods to like 1b each mod level->plate->mwd->pashans->omega asc
